title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
**The Role**
 The Forward Deployed AI Engineer will work directly with clients and senior engineers to build AI\-powered systems inside real enterprise environments. This role is ideal for a strong junior engineer who wants to work on practical AI systems, enterprise data, agents, retrieval, workflow automation, and context graphs. You will help connect to client systems, process messy real\-world data, build prototypes, and turn business problems into working software.
   

  

 The work is hands\-on and client\-facing:
   

  

* Understand operational workflows and convert them into technical artifacts
* Connect to real enterprise systems and data sources
* Build context\-aware AI agents, retrieval systems, and automation prototypes
* Help move the best prototypes toward reliable production deployments


**Requirements**
**Build context graphs.** 
 Help ingest, clean, structure, and connect data from enterprise systems into context graph. This may include structured databases, PDFs, spreadsheets, tickets, CRM data, analytics events, Slack or Teams exports, meeting transcripts, operational workflows, and other internal knowledge sources.
   

  

**Develop AI and agentic workflows.** 
 Build AI pipelines and agent\-based systems that can reason over enterprise context, identify patterns, surface workflow gaps, and suggest or trigger automations. This may involve LLMs, retrieval systems, structured extraction, tool use, LangGraph\-style workflows, and agent harnesses.
   

  

**Connect to enterprise systems** 
 . Integrate with client infrastructure such as databases, APIs, cloud storage, document repositories, analytics tools, ticketing systems, and internal applications.
   

  

**Prototype automation opportunities.** 
 Rapidly build proof\-of\-concepts that show how AI can improve a client's operations \- for example, process documentation, workflow discovery, incident management, document extraction, customer journey analysis, or operational decision support.
   

  

**Turn messy business problems into software.** 
 Work with senior engineers and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous operational problems into technical designs, data models, prompts, pipelines, and deployed applications.
   

  

**Support production deployments.** 
 Help build reliable, maintainable systems that can run in production environments, including client cloud environments when needed.
   

  

**Ideal Candidate**
 We are looking for a strong junior software engineer who is excited about applied AI and wants to build real systems, not just experiments.
   

  

 You do not need to be an expert in every area below, but you should be curious, technical, and comfortable learning quickly.
   

  

**Technical Background**
* Strong Python fundamentals
* Basic backend development experience
* Familiarity with APIs, databases, and cloud services
* Interest in LLMs, agents, retrieval, structured outputs, and tool\-calling
* Familiarity with data pipelines and messy real\-world datasets
* Experience with FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, vector databases, document processing, or knowledge graphs is a plus
* AWS experience is a plus
* Experience with enterprise data, analytics, or workflow automation is a strong plus


**What Makes Someone Successful In This Role**
* You like figuring out how businesses actually operate
* You are comfortable working with incomplete, messy, or poorly documented data
* You can move quickly from vague requirements to a working prototype
* You care about building useful systems, not just impressive demos
* You communicate clearly with both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* You are curious about how AI agents can interact with real tools, data, and workflows
* You want to learn how to deploy AI into real enterprise environments


**Why This Role Is Interesting**
 You will work on the frontier of practical enterprise AI: connecting AI agents to real company context and using that context to discover and automate high\-value workflows.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who wants to grow into building production\-grade AI systems across data, agents, infrastructure, and enterprise software

title: AI Engineer
description:
We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong hands\-on experience in deploying and scaling Large Language Model (LLM) solutions in production environments. The role focuses on building high\-performance, multilingual (especially Arabic\-English) AI systems using open\-source models on self\-managed GPU infrastructure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, and optimize LLM\-powered applications in production environments
* Build and maintain Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with robust retrieval and ranking strategies
* Implement scalable inference systems using high\-throughput serving frameworks
* Develop and fine\-tune transformer\-based models using parameter\-efficient techniques
* Ensure high\-quality outputs through evaluation frameworks and custom benchmarking
* Handle multilingual data processing, with a focus on Arabic and RTL text handling
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into business applications
* Implement guardrails for safety, compliance, and output control



  





**Core Technical Skills (Must\-Have)** 



* Proven experience deploying open\-source LLMs (e.g., Llama, Falcon, Jais, Mistral) on GPU\-based infrastructure
* Strong hands\-on with inference frameworks such as vLLM, Text Generation Inference, or similar
* Production experience with RAG pipelines: chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and query optimization
* Expertise in vector databases (pgvector, ChromaDB preferred; also Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus)
* Experience with multilingual embeddings and RTL language processing
* Fine\-tuning expertise using LoRA, QLoRA, or other PEFT methods
* Experience with LLM evaluation tools (RAGAS, TruLens) and building custom evaluation workflows
* Strong programming skills in Python with PyTorch and Hugging Face ecosystem
* Experience with frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex
* Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU environments (CUDA, multi\-GPU inference, parallelism, NVLink)



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience building or working with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
* Hands\-on exposure to regional LLMs such as Falcon or Jais
* Strong background in Arabic NLP (normalization, tokenization, dialect handling, diacritics)
* Advanced prompt engineering (few\-shot, structured prompting, instruction tuning)
* Experience implementing AI safety/guardrails (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI)
* Kubernetes experience managing GPU workloads and NVIDIA operators
* Experience with Document AI tools (e.g., PDF rendering, Puppeteer) supporting RTL/LTR formats

title: AI engineer
description:
Master Works is seeking an AI Engineer with strong generative AI prototyping experience to rapidly turn ideas into working AI\-powered demos, proofs of concept, and early\-stage products. The role sits between research and production engineering — combining hands\-on use of large language models, multimodal models, retrieval\-augmented generation, and agent frameworks to validate feasibility, explore new capabilities, and de\-risk feature delivery. The role is central to accelerating AI innovation across the data, analytics, and intelligence portfolio, with a particular emphasis on bilingual (Arabic/English) AI use cases.

* Rapidly design and build generative\-AI prototypes and proofs of concept — from initial idea to working demo — using modern LLM APIs, open\-source models, and prototyping frameworks.
* Design and implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking strategies, embedding generation, vector storage, and retrieval orchestration.
* Build agentic systems that use tool/function calling, planning, and multi\-step reasoning to automate complex tasks; integrate AI agents with internal APIs, databases, and external services.
* Engineer prompts, system instructions, and structured\-output schemas; iterate on prompt design through measurable evaluation rather than guesswork.
* Work with multimodal AI capabilities — text, vision, speech (STT/TTS), and document understanding — and combine them into coherent end\-to\-end AI pipelines.
* Build and run AI evaluation frameworks (offline benchmarks, LLM\-as\-judge, golden\-set regression testing) to measure quality, accuracy, latency, and cost across model and prompt variants.
* Adapt and fine\-tune open\-source models (LoRA, QLoRA, full fine\-tuning) when proprietary or domain\-specific behaviour is required, especially for Arabic\-language tasks.
* Apply responsible\-AI practices — safety filtering, hallucination mitigation, prompt\-injection defence, PII handling, and bias awareness — especially for sensitive or regulated environments.
* Hand off mature prototypes to production engineering teams, providing clear documentation, evaluation results, deployment notes, and migration guidance.
* Demo prototypes and AI capabilities to internal stakeholders and clients; explain technical concepts, limitations, and risks to non\-technical audiences.
* Track and evaluate fast\-moving developments in the generative\-AI ecosystem (new models, tools, techniques, and providers) and recommend adoption where they materially improve outcomes.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with product, design, data, and software engineering teams to shape AI features end\-to\-end and ensure they deliver real user value.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification (MSc/PhD) in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, or a related field is preferred.
* Recognised certifications in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, or cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) are a strong plus.
* 3–5\+ years of AI/ML engineering experience, with at least 1–2 years hands\-on building generative\-AI applications using modern LLMs.
* Demonstrable portfolio of shipped prototypes or production AI features — ideally including RAG systems, AI agents, or multimodal pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience with leading LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini) and open\-source model serving (e.g., Hugging Face, vLLM, Ollama).
* Strong Python proficiency, including modern AI libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain or LlamaIndex, and standard data tooling.
* Working experience with embedding models, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, FAISS), and retrieval evaluation techniques.
* Familiarity with rapid\-prototyping tools (Streamlit, Gradio, Jupyter), API integration, and lightweight web back\-ends.
* Experience designing AI evaluation harnesses (offline benchmarks, LLM\-as\-judge, golden sets) and using observability/tracing tools for AI systems.
* Exposure to fine\-tuning techniques (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) and to Arabic\-language NLP is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of containerisation (Docker), version control (Git), and cloud AI platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI) is a strong plus.
* Excellent leadership and team development skills.
* Strong bias for action and a rapid\-prototyping mindset; able to ship a working demo in days, not months.
* Comfortable working under uncertainty — rapidly forming hypotheses, running experiments, and iterating based on evidence.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the discipline to evaluate AI behaviour quantitatively rather than relying on intuition alone.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to demo AI capabilities and explain technical concepts, limitations, and risks to non\-technical audiences.
* Curiosity and continuous\-learning mindset; actively follows the rapidly evolving generative\-AI landscape and brings new ideas back to the team.
* Collaborative team player; comfortable in cross\-functional teams of researchers, software engineers, designers, and client business owners.
* Cultural awareness and sensitivity, particularly when designing AI experiences for Arabic\-speaking users in regional contexts.

title: AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world's leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the **FinTech** connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers **better interest rates** and banks a **diversified form of refinancing**. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.



Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from **more than one million investors** which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

**Team**
--------



The AI Enablement team supports the adoption of AI capabilities across Raisin's products and internal systems.



The team focuses on establishing a consistent and reliable approach to using AI in production by providing shared foundations, guidance, and reusable solutions. This includes working with engineering teams to integrate AI into existing systems, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with security and regulatory requirements.



The scope ranges from improving internal workflows to enabling new product capabilities, depending on where AI can deliver measurable value.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------



As an AI Engineer, you will help shape how AI is applied across the organization by combining hands\-on engineering with enablement and guidance.


#### **Enable teams to adopt AI effectively**


Work with product and engineering teams to identify and refine AI use cases  

* 

Support teams in integrating AI capabilities into their systems and workflows by providing clear guidance on patterns, trade\-offs, and practical implementation approaches  
* 
* Promote consistent and reusable solutions to reduce fragmentation across teams

#### **Contribute to shared capabilities where needed**


Develop or extend shared components, integrations, or services when required to unblock teams  

* 

Define and implement patterns for integrating LLM capabilities into the platform  
* 

Contribute to shared components or lightweight services that simplify access to AI capabilities across teams  
* 

Manage AI costs and budget usage when providing shared model access and services to other teams.  
* 
* Support teams in developing retrieval\-based approaches that make internal knowledge accessible to AI\-driven use cases

#### **Guide technical decisions**


Evaluate tools, platforms, and approaches with consideration for scalability, security, and maintainability  

* 

Help teams choose appropriate solutions based on context rather than applying AI by default  
* 
* Contribute to establishing a pragmatic and consistent approach to AI usage

#### **Ensure robustness and responsible usage**


Optimize AI system efficiency by making principled model selections based on cost\-performance trade\-offs, inference latency, and token usage optimization  

*

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll be at the heart of that transformation, building advanced agentic products that solve high\-value problems. You will act as a product owner for the AI agents you create, turning them into reusable applications that solve concrete customer problems at scale in the financial crime or credit risk space.


If you're passionate about applying AI to real\-world financial decisioning, stay current on advances in generative AI, and bring a solid foundation in Python, SQL, and working with APIs, you'll thrive here.

**What You'll Do as an Sr. Applied AI Engineer**

* You are eager to dive into the domain of our customers, including credit underwriting, financial risk assessment, and financial crime detection.

* You excel at breaking down complex problems and abstracting them into scalable, reusable solutions.
* You build strong relationships with both technical and business stakeholders at all levels, driven by a product\-centric mindset to understand their needs and solve their challenges at scale.
* You are open to a hybrid work model and can work from our NYC office at least three days per week.

**Ideal Qualifications (but not required)**

* You have experience in building AI applications within financial services.
* You have experience in applying and optimizing statistical and machine learning models to solve business problems.
* You have experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**What We Offer**

* Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
* Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early\-stage company.
* Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

* Receive a top\-of\-market equity and cash compensation package.
* Get access to a self\-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.
* Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set\-up.

**Our Stance**

* We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
* We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control.


By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision\-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve.


Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision\-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry.


We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. title: Founding AI Engineer
description:
The construction industry loses
 **$1\.6 trillion annually** 
 to inefficiencies — not because people are careless, but because critical knowledge is trapped in PDFs, transcripts, and scattered systems. Every new project starts from scratch.
 


  


 We're building the opposite: an AI co\-worker that extends the
 **Projektsteuerer** 
 (the person who runs complex construction projects), while every project makes our system measurably better. The moat isn't the model — it's the compounding project memory no competitor can replicate.
 


  


 Pre\-seed led by
 **Realyze Ventures** 
 — LPs include Zech and other major European construction groups. Co\-investors:
 **D11Z** 
 (the family office behind Aleph Alpha) and the
 **CDTM Venture Fund** 
 (backed by 300\+ CDTM alumni including founders of Personio, Alasco and the Technical Director of DeepMind).
 


  


 Our software is running today on a
 **major autobahn construction program** 
 and an
 **S\-Bahn transit program** 
 — multi\-year timelines, hundreds of thousands of pages of specs, protocols, and communications. Real consequences when we get it wrong.
 


  

 Tasks
   


**What you'd actually work on** 



  

  
* \*\*1\. Agent harness engineering for construction documents
   

  

 \*\*One summary doesn't fit all. "Structural risk" in an RFI means something different than in a cost review, which means something different in a schedule reconciliation. We build multi\-agent harnesses — specialized extraction, reasoning, evaluation stages — that route 400\-page tender documents and protocol archives to the right pipeline with the right context.
   

  

 If you've read Anthropic's or LangChain's writing on agent harnesses and thought "yes, that's the hard part of shipping production agents" — that's this job.
  
* \*\*2\. Project memory as a compounding moat
   

  

 \*\*We started with meeting transcripts. We're building a decision graph that grows with every project — tracking not just what was decided, but why, by whom, against which alternatives, and with what outcome. That graph feeds the next project. Every closed workflow makes the next one faster.
   

  

 This is the operational\-continuity layer no ConTech player is building. We want someone who gets excited that the hard part here is not retrieval — it's deciding what signal to keep.
  
* \*\*3\. Context compression for 5 year projects
   

  

 \*\*What should the system remember? Forget? Surface at which decision point? There's no clean top\-k answer when a project spans 5 years and touches 50 stakeholders. This is an open research problem we're solving in production — and we'd rather hire someone who reads papers than someone who installs libraries.
  


  


**Stack:** 
 TypeScript, Next.js, Vercel, Supabase (Postgres \+ pgvector), LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, LangFuse, shadcn/ui.
 **€500/month AI tooling budget** 
 per engineer — Claude Code, Cursor background agents, experimentation with frontier models. No legacy. Greenfield.
 


  

 Requirements
   


**Who we're looking for** 



  

  
* **Product sense:** 
 you reason from user pain → solution → measurable outcome. You can talk to non\-technical customers and understand their workflows.
  
* **Velocity \+ craft:** 
 prototype fast, measure everything, iterate on real feedback. But you care about reliability because the downside of wrong is real in construction.
  
* **Comfort with the unknown:** 
 many of these problems don't have Stack Overflow answers. You read papers, prototype, and compare approaches.
  
* **Bonus** 
 : strong open\-source work, previous early\-employee startup experience, domain depth in document understanding or agent systems, or shipped systems that replaced hours of human labor.
  
* **Level is opportunistic:** 
 We've seen brilliant new grads outperform staff engineers and vice versa. If you're exceptional, we'll find the right scope.
  
* **Language:** 
 We work in English. German is nice\-to\-have for customer conversations but
 **not required** 
 — we have native speakers for that.
  


  

 Benefits
   


 As one of our first hires, you’ll do more than contribute — you’ll help
 **shape** 
 how Alago works: our culture, systems, and growth strategy. You’ll work directly with the founders, gain exposure to every function, and ship projects that have immediate impact.
 


  

  
* **10× Learning Curve.** 
 Work with cutting\-edge AI to tackle real\-world challenges every day
  
* **Work directly with the founders.** 
 You’ll own critical parts of alago end\-to\-end, laying the technical foundation while balancing rapid iteration, customer value, and long\-term scalability.
  
* **Hybrid:** 
**A vibrant in\-office culture in our central Munich office** 
 . 3 days per week in our central Munich office, flexible otherwise.
  
* **Meaningful equity stake: 0\.5% – 1\.5%** 
 (4\-year vest, 1\.5\-year cliff)
  
* **Your needs and well\-being matter to us** 
 . You’ll get access to sponsored EGYM Wellpass to find inner peace at yoga or kill it at HIIT workouts.
  


  


 We’re building for scale — but right now, it’s still early. That means lots of autonomy, tight feedback loops, and the freedom to grow into whatever role suits your strengths, whether that’s become top individual contributor or stepping into leadership roles like VP Engineering.
 


  

  
2. **Three stages. No five\-round loops.**

title: AI Backend Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
**paretos** is the leading AI\-based Decision Intelligence platform for effective, data\-driven decisions across entire enterprises. Our Business Agents make it possible to evaluate complex data volumes, predict scenarios, and derive optimal actions — from demand forecasting and replenishment to strategic C\-level decisions. All through a code\-free interface, with no prior data science knowledge required.  

paretos is an inclusive company with equal opportunities for all. Our culture is guided by the principles of **GUNG HO**: meaningful work, shared goals, and mutual support. We are proud of a team of passionate, high\-performing, and caring people of all genders, cultures, and backgrounds.



As AI Backend Engineer, you work in a hybrid setup, with 1–2 days per week in our Heidelberg office in close collaboration with Product, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Data Science colleagues. We look forward to your application if you already **live in the Rhine\-Neckar region or are willing to relocate**.


**Tasks**
---------



As an AI Backend Engineer, you will build the technical backbone of our Decision Intelligence platform. You develop scalable backend services that bring our forecasting and optimization models, our AI agent Socrates, and our semantic data layer into productive use. You work agentically and AI\-first: Claude Code, MCPs, and custom skills are your standard toolkit. You think not only in terms of endpoints and databases, but in customer value, product impact, and adoption.


* You **design, build, and operate scalable backend services** in Python with FastAPI and Pydantic that productively support forecasting, replenishment, and agent workflows.
* You **design clean API contracts** between the platform, agents, ML models, frontend, and customer systems (ERP, BI, planning tools) and ensure robustness and observability.
* You build and extend our **semantic data layer as the foundation for accurate forecasts and precise responses** from our agent Socrates: modeling in PostgreSQL, transformations with dbt, pipelines, caching, and retrieval.
* You **integrate LLM and agent systems deeply into the backend**: tool use, function calling, RAG pipelines, eval frameworks for LLM outputs, guardrails, and production deployment.
* You work **agentically and AI\-first**. Claude Code, vibe engineering, and subagents are part of your daily toolkit, and you continuously extend our internal setup (CLAUDE, hooks, skills, plan/execute/review loop).
* You translate business and customer requirements into viable technical solutions together with FDEs and Product, and **make pragmatic trade\-offs between speed, scalability, and maintainability**.
* You think in terms of impact and have a **strong product mindset**: you measure whether your features actually achieve adoption, observe usage patterns, and sharpen the next iteration together with Product and FDE.
* You **prototype quickly and close to the user**: you put new ideas into the hands of FDEs and customers in days rather than weeks, gather early feedback, iterate closely on the actual workflow, and decide based on real usage what is worth hardening and rolling out.

**Requirements**
----------------


* **2 to 5 years of professional experience** as a Backend, Software, or AI Engineer in a product\-oriented environment — ideally in a product or SaaS context, startup experience welcome.
* Solid **backend foundation**: Python with FastAPI and Pydantic, clean API design, asynchronous programming, PostgreSQL and Redis, containerization with Docker, and experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* **Strong product mindset**: you don't just ask "How do I build this?" but "What are we building this for, for whom, and how will we know it has impact?". You think in terms of users, adoption, and chains of impact, not just tickets.
* Practical **experience with LLMs and agent systems**: prompt engineering, tool use/function calling, RAG, eval frameworks, and production deployment.
* Experience with **cloud infrastructure**, ideally AWS, as well as a good feel for Kubernetes and Infrastructure\-as\-Code with Terraform — you don't need to master everything in your sleep, but you should be able to move confidently in this space.
* High level of **ownership, appetite for ambiguity, and motivation to continuously develop yourself** in backend engineering, agentic engineering, and your product perspective.
* Clear, compelling **communication**, both technical and non\-technical, with low ego.
* Fluent English, bonus: native German or C1 level.

**Benefits**
------------


* You receive the hardware setup you need to unlock your full potential.
* You use your personal learning budget (€2,000 per year) to continuously develop yourself.
* Flexible working hours: you work when it suits you best.
* You receive a mobility budget for sustainable transportation and reduced CO₂ emissions.
* A rich selection of snacks and drinks is available to you free of charge in the office at all times.
* You get direct access to frontier AI developments and learning sessions in close exchange with our product development.
* You complement a highly qualified and motivated team of paretoneers who get things done and have fun doing it.
* You take part in our quarterly Hacky Days, full of creativity and new ideas.
* We regularly host professional and social team events, both online and on site.
* If you are a member of the paretos Dog Club, you are welcome to bring your four\-legged friend to the office.
* In the office, you can prove your barista skills and have coffee conversations with other paretoneers. Maybe you'll be crowned "paretos Office Barista of the Year" at our Christmas party.


Transparency notice: We use AI tools to pre\-screen applications. However, the decision on who we meet is always made by us – not by the algorithm.



paretos is an inclusive company with equal opportunities for all. We explicitly encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements.

title: Sr. Applied AI Engineer
description:
**About The Role**


Taktile is redefining how financial institutions use AI to make critical decisions, and we're growing fast. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll be at the heart of that transformation, building advanced agentic products that solve high\-value problems. You will act as a product owner for the AI agents you create, turning them into reusable applications that solve concrete customer problems at scale in the financial crime or credit risk space.


If you're passionate about applying AI to real\-world financial decisioning, stay current on advances in generative AI, and bring a solid foundation in Python, SQL, and working with APIs, you'll thrive here.

**What You'll Do as an Sr. Applied AI Engineer**

* **Build Reusable AI Products:** Act as the product owner for your application area. Design, develop, and deploy robust, repeatable Generative AI agents that serve as configurable solutions for our customers.
* **Drive Scalable Value:** Partner with Solution and Forward Deployed Engineers during critical sales and implementation projects to deeply understand customer needs. Develop standard templates and reusable components that reduce time\-to\-activation and solve core challenges.
* **Product Vision and Iteration:** Synthesize customer feedback into a clear vision for your agents. Iterate on your solutions to solve concrete use cases at scale, treating every agent as a product itself.
* **Collaborate with Core Product:** Work closely with the core product team to prioritize platform features that unblock application development, and act as an expert user consultant during the development of new features.

**About You**

* You bring 3\-6 years of data science, software engineering, consulting, or product management experience that includes customer\-facing work or product ownership.
* You have a strong technical or quantitative background, preferably in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or Economics.
* You are eager to dive into the domain of our customers, including credit underwriting, financial risk assessment, and financial crime detection.
* You write clean, maintainable Python and SQL, and have a good understanding of REST APIs.
* You excel at breaking down complex problems and abstracting them into scalable, reusable solutions.
* You build strong relationships with both technical and business stakeholders at all levels, driven by a product\-centric mindset to understand their needs and solve their challenges at scale.
* You are open to a hybrid work model and can work from our NYC office at least three days per week.

**Ideal Qualifications (but not required)**

* You have experience in building AI applications within financial services.
* You have experience in applying and optimizing statistical and machine learning models to solve business problems.
* You have experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

**What We Offer**

* Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
* Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early\-stage company.
* Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
* Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.
* Receive a top\-of\-market equity and cash compensation package.
* Get access to a self\-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.
* Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set\-up.

**Our Stance**

* We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
* We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

**About Us**


Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control.


By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision\-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve.


Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision\-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry.


We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast\-growing startups and enterprise leaders.


Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath \- we’re building a world\-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI\-driven decision\-making in financial services.

description:
****Change Software Forever****
 QA slows the world down. Flaky tests kill trust, stall releases, and bleed engineering velocity.
   

  

 Duku AI is ending that era.
   

  

 We’re building autonomous agents that
 **think like engineers**
 : they run every critical user journey, catch failures before users do, and self\-heal as the codebase evolves. Real AI teammates, not test scripts that break on impact.

We know what elite execution looks like and we’re hunting for one more builder to help us rewrite the rules of software quality.
   

  

****Why This Role is Different****
**About**
 Most “AI engineer” jobs are just applying models someone else built. This isn’t that. This is about pushing RL to its edge:
   

  

* Agents that think: networks that see and understand apps through vision, structure, and behavior.
* Agents that explore: curiosity\-driven RL that uncovers edge cases no human would think of.
* Agents that learn: smarter with every bug, sharper with every correction.
* Agents that scale: millions of states, thousands of sessions, decisions in sub\-seconds.


 If you’ve ever wanted to take RL out of papers and into the wild, this is it.
   

  

**What You’ll Achieve**
 In your first three months, you’ll see your reinforcement learning prototypes running live inside real applications, surfacing bugs no human ever noticed.
   

  

 By six months, those agents will have evolved , scaling across multiple environments, learning and adapting in ways that prove this isn’t theory but reality.
   

  

 And within a year, the intelligence you’ve built will sit at the heart of every release for our first customers, powering their ability to ship AI\-generated code with confidence.
   

  

****What You Bring (****
 Non\-Negotiables)
   

  

* 5\+ years shipping ML to production (real systems, not papers).
* Deep RL expertise , you think in Q\-values and policy gradients.
* Experience building autonomous agents that actually work at scale.
* Python/PyTorch mastery.


****The Stuff That Matters****
* You’re obsessed with solving “impossible” problems.
* You’d rather ship and learn than debate in theory.
* You can explain RL to a CEO and optimize it for a GPU cluster.
* You thrive in chaos and see it as opportunity.


****Why Join Now****
* Impact: You won’t be “joining a team.” You’ll be the team that defines how software is built in the age of AI. Your code won’t sit in a corner , it will become the backbone of a new category.
* Market: Software testing hasn’t changed in 30 years. AI\-generated code has rewritten the rules overnight. Whoever solves this bottleneck doesn’t just win a market , they reshape the entire industry.
* Team: Small, elite, no passengers. You’ll be working side by side with a CTO who built this at Meta and a founding team that’s scaled some of the fastest\-growing tech companies on the planet.
* Timing: Rarely do technology shifts and career timing line up. This is one of those moments. Five years from now, autonomous QA will be a given. Right now, it’s unsolved , and you could be the one who solves it.


****The Challenge****
 Big tech tried to brute\-force this problem and hit a wall. Most startups never got past brittle scripts. The reason is simple: building true autonomy takes more than patching frameworks , it takes intelligence. That’s the path we’re on. Your system will need to:
   

  

* Navigate the chaos of modern web apps.
* Learn from sparse, delayed rewards.
* Balance exploration with validation.
* Transfer knowledge across completely different applications.


 It won’t be easy. That’s the point.
   

  

**What You Get**
* Equity that actually moves the needle , not token options, but a real ownership stake in what could be the category\-defining AI company of the decade.
* Unlimited firepower , the hardware, compute, and resources you need to push RL further than anyone has before.
* A seat at the table, not a cog in the machine, you’ll be in the room where every decision is made, shaping both the product and the company.
* Speed over politics , a London base where execution beats process, every time.
* A shot at legacy , work that will outlive your CV, the kind of achievement you’ll still be talking about 20 years from now.


 To win the space, we’re looking for the best people in London, with 10/10 ambition and work ethic to join us and build a product people love.

**About The Role**

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll be at the heart of that transformation, helping to build advanced agentic products that solve high\-value problems. You will take ownership of the AI agents you create, turning them into reusable applications that solve concrete customer problems at scale in the credit underwriting and financial risk space.
   

  

 If you're passionate about applying AI to real\-world financial decisioning, stay current on advances in generative AI, and bring a solid foundation in Python, SQL, and working with APIs, you'll thrive here.

* Drive scalable value: Collaborate with Solution and Forward Deployed Engineers during sales and implementation projects to understand customer needs. Contribute to standard templates and reusable components that reduce time\-to\-activation.
* Product vision and iteration: Synthesize customer feedback to improve your agents. Iterate on your solutions to solve use cases at scale.
* Collaborate with core product teams: Work closely with the core product team to prioritize platform features that unblock application development, and act as an expert user consultant during the development of new features.


**About You**
* You bring 1\-4 years of engineering, data science, or product management experience
* You are eager to dive into the domain of our customers, including credit underwriting and financial risk assessment.
* You are eager to develop a strong product sense by learning how to break down complex problems and turn customer needs into scalable, reusable solutions.
* You have a strong technical or quantitative background, preferably in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, Data Science, or Economics.
* You build strong relationships with stakeholders, driven by a curiosity to understand their needs and solve their challenges.
* You write clean, maintainable Python and SQL, and have a good understanding of REST APIs.
* You are open to a hybrid work model and can work from your local office at least three days per week.


**Ideal Qualifications (but Not Required)**
* You have relevant internship or project experience in consulting, fintech, or investing; B2B SaaS experience is a plus.
* You have experience applying statistical and machine learning models to solve real\-world problems.


**What we offer**
* Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.
* Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early\-stage company.
* Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.
* Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.
* Receive a top\-of\-market equity and cash compensation package.
* Get access to a self\-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.
* Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set\-up.


**Our Stance**
* We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.
* We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.


**About Us**
 Taktile helps financial institutions make smarter, safer decisions with the power of AI. Our software gives teams the tools to automate complex decisions — like who to onboard, how to underwrite, or when to flag suspicious activity — with full visibility and control.
   

  

 By combining AI with a rich ecosystem of financial data, Taktile enables companies to adapt their decision\-making in real time as markets, customer behavior, and risks evolve.
   

  

 Our mission is to build the world’s leading platform for automated decision\-making in financial services — setting the standard for how AI is applied responsibly and effectively in this industry.
   

  

 We were founded by machine learning and data science experts with deep experience in financial services. Today, our team works across Berlin, London, and New York, bringing together engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers from companies like Google, Amazon, and Meta, as well as fast\-growing startups and enterprise leaders.
   

  

 Backed by top investors including Y Combinator, Index Ventures, Balderton Capital, and Tiger Global, along with the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath \- we’re building a world\-class organization across all functions and levels to power the next generation of AI\-driven decision\-making in financial services.

**Company:**

Marsh
**Description:**
----------------


**What can you expect?**

Marsh is a global leader in insurance broking and risk management, serving clients in over 130 countries. The AI Center of Excellence is a newly formed team with a singular mission: get emerging AI capabilities into the hands of Marsh engineers and business teams as fast as the technology landscape moves.


We're looking for an AI Engineer who wants to live on the cutting edge of AI. You'll be the person who picks up preview\-stage technologies — new LLM approaches, memory systems, agentic deployment frameworks, guardrails, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling — runs rapid proofs\-of\-concept and turns the successful ones into production\-ready capabilities that the rest of Marsh can adopt.


This is an individual contributor role, but you'll become the recognised subject\-matter expert in one or more AI technology areas. That means coaching your peers in the AI CoE, presenting internally, and — critically — ensuring that both human engineers and autonomous AI coding agents across the enterprise are configured to use these technologies correctly and select them ahead of alternatives.


**We will count on you to:**

* **Run focused proofs\-of\-concept** — typically one or two at a time — to evaluate emerging AI technologies against real Marsh use cases, moving from experiment to recommendation at speed
* **Select and recommend technologies** for adoption, producing clear guidance on when and why to use them
* **Productionise chosen capabilities** with repeatable, infrastructure\-as\-code deployment patterns using Crossplane across AWS, Azure, and other hyperscaler clouds, then hand operational ownership to the appropriate platform teams
* **Direct AI coding agents** (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, and others) — ensuring they are technically configured to leverage new technologies, select them appropriately, and follow Marsh standards
* **Become a subject\-matter expert** in one or more AI technology domains (e.g. memory and retrieval, agent orchestration, guardrails and safety, MCP tooling) and coach peers across Marsh on those topics
* **Engage with business units** across Marsh through architecture forums, dev councils, and other channels to understand needs and feed requirements back into the PoC pipeline
* **Share knowledge internally** through blog posts, demos, and presentations — keeping the wider engineering community informed about what's coming and what's ready

**What you need to have:**
--------------------------

* Strong software engineering experience in **Python and/or TypeScript** , with a track record of shipping production systems — not just prototypes
* Hands\-on experience with **AI engineering** : integrating, deploying, instrumenting, and operating LLM\-based systems (prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, function calling, agent frameworks, evaluation, observability)
* Experience writing **infrastructure\-as\-code** for cloud deployments (Crossplane preferred; Terraform, Pulumi, or CDK experience transfers well)
* Comfort working across **multiple cloud platforms** (AWS, Azure, GCP) rather than deep specialism in one
* Strong intellectual curiosity and high standards — you actively track emerging technology, learn quickly, and care about doing excellent work
* The ability to evaluate a new technology quickly and form a clear recommendation
* Excellent communication skills, able to explain a complex technical decision to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders

**What makes you stand out:**
-----------------------------

* Breadth of programming language experience beyond Python/TypeScript — **Rust, Go** , or others that demonstrate curiosity and range
* Familiarity with **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** — building or consuming MCP servers and tools
* Experience with **Crossplane** or Kubernetes\-based infrastructure management
* Exposure to **AI safety and guardrails** frameworks (content filtering, prompt injection defence, output validation)
* Experience configuring or extending **AI coding assistants** (custom instructions, tool integration, workspace configuration)
* Background in **fine\-tuning or adapting** foundation models

**What makes this role different:**
-----------------------------------

* **You'll use things before anyone else.** Preview APIs, beta frameworks, technologies that don't have Stack Overflow answers yet.
* **You'll shape technical direction.** Your PoC outcomes and recommendations directly influence which technologies Marsh adopts across the enterprise.
* **You'll onboard humans and machines.** You'll ensure that AI coding agents across the organisation are configured to use the right tools in the right way.
* **You'll be one of the first members of the AI CoE.** You'll help shape ways of working, team culture, and technical standards as the team grows.
* **You'll have the tools you need.** Access to AI models, tools, tokens, and broader professional development opportunities.

**Why join our team:**
----------------------

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.

title: Ingénieur en IA / AI Engineer
description:
#### **The Company**


Everflow is a SaaS Partner Marketing platform for managing and scaling revenue from affiliates, partnerships, and marketing channels.


Founded in 2016 by industry veterans, we have a team distributed across the NAM and EMEA regions.


We’re a bootstrapped and profitable company (over $30M ARR) that has grown through supporting happy customers that refer business to us and create word\-of\-mouth excitement. We’re the go\-to platform for brands, agencies, and networks, with 1,100\+ customers including top brands, agencies and networks*.*

 **Ingénieur en IA**


Ingénierie  

Montréal, Canada

**L'entreprise**
----------------


Everflow est une plateforme de marketing de partenariat SaaS conçue pour gérer et accroître les revenus provenant des affiliés, des partenariats et des canaux marketing.


Fondée en 2016 par des vétérans de l’industrie, notre équipe est répartie à travers les régions NAM (Amérique du Nord) et EMEA (Europe, Moyen\-Orient et Afrique).


Nous sommes une entreprise autofinancée et rentable (plus de 30 M$ de revenus annuels récurrents) qui a connu une croissance soutenue grâce à la satisfaction de nos clients, qui recommandent nos services et génèrent un engouement naturel. Nous sommes la plateforme de référence pour les marques, les agences et les réseaux, comptant plus de 1 100 clients, dont des leaders de l’industrie.

**À propos du poste**
---------------------


Everflow gère une échelle massive dans le domaine de la technologie publicitaire (ad\-tech). Nous recherchons un ingénieur en IA qui considère les modèles de langage (LLM) comme un élément parmi d'autres au sein d'un système distribué complexe et à haute concurrence. Vous serez le fer de lance de notre évolution, faisant passer notre plateforme d'une approche « riche en données » à une approche « pilotée par l'intelligence ».


Nous utilisons l'écosystème GCP, mais nous ne nous contentons pas de suivre la documentation : nous innovons pour prendre de l'avance. Vous serez responsable de l'architecture de l'intégration de Gemini et de la suite évolutive Vertex AI au sein de notre moteur d'attribution et d'analytique en temps réel.

**La mission : Bâtir pour aujourd'hui, concevoir pour demain**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* **Orchestration système :** Concevoir le « tissu conjonctif » entre nos vastes ensembles de données BigQuery et nos flux de travail d'IA agentique.
* **Adaptation rapide :** Évaluer et implémenter les technologies émergentes de GCP (y compris celles annoncées lors du Cloud Next) pour maintenir Everflow à la fine pointe du marketing technologique (Mar\-Tech).
* **IA résiliente :** S'assurer que les fonctionnalités propulsées par l'IA — comme la détection automatisée de la fraude ou les insights sur les partenaires — soient déterministes, économiquement viables et ultra\-rapides.

**Ce que vous ferez**
---------------------

* **Agilité architecturale :** Concevoir des services d'IA modulaires nous permettant de remplacer les modèles ou les cadres d'orchestration (ex. : passer d'un RAG manuel à des agents autonomes Vertex AI) à mesure que l'écosystème GCP évolue.
* **Outils et appel de fonctions (Function Calling) :** Développer des couches API sécurisées permettant à Gemini d'agir au nom de nos utilisateurs au sein de l'écosystème Everflow.
* **Contrôle de la latence et des coûts :** Concevoir le « middleware » gérant le routage des modèles, la mise en cache sémantique et la gestion des budgets de jetons (tokens) pour préserver nos marges.
* **MLOps collaboratif :** Travailler de concert avec nos scientifiques des données pour déployer les modèles, des carnets d'expérimentation vers des environnements de production sur Cloud Run/GKE.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Ingénieur aux principes fondamentaux solides :** Vous comprenez les bases des systèmes distribués, la concurrence et l'intégrité des données.
* **Expert GCP :** Solide expérience avec l'écosystème Google Cloud (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, GKE) et Vertex AI.
* **Bilinguisme :** Une excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est requise.
* **Basé à Montréal :** Capacité à travailler depuis notre bureau de Montréal au moins deux jours par semaine pour favoriser une collaboration riche au sein de notre pôle d'ingénierie local.
* **Sensibilité Ad\-Tech :** Vous comprenez que dans notre domaine, la latence est l'ennemi et la précision est le produit.

**Avantages et rémunération**
-----------------------------

* **Salaire de base :** 100 000 $\- 110 000$ CAD
* **Prime au rendement**
* **Avantages sociaux :**
* + Plans d'assurance collective médicale et dentaire fournis par l'employeur.
	+ Congés payés illimités et jours fériés chômés.
	+ Congé parental payé pour donner la priorité à votre famille.
	+ Environnement de type startup, sans la pression constante liée à la recherche de financement.
	+ Une équipe et une culture hautement collaboratives.
	+ Allocation pour la formation, l'abonnement au gym et l'équipement.

**Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle**
-----------------------------------------


Plongez dans un rôle où le respect, l'appropriation et la pleine conscience définissent notre culture. En tant que membre précieux de l'équipe, vous profiterez de la liberté d'innover et d'exceller, soutenu par les outils et l'équipement nécessaires à votre réussite.

### **Équilibre, croissance et connexion**

* **Harmonie travail/vie personnelle :** Profitez de congés illimités et d'un équilibre sain qui respecte votre vie en dehors du travail.
* **Croissance continue :** Des rétroactions régulières et des discussions sur votre cheminement de carrière vous permettent de progresser constamment.
* **Communauté inclusive :** Faites partie d'un milieu de travail accueillant et stimulant qui célèbre la diversité et le plaisir.


Nous offrons un environnement dynamique où l'excellence est récompensée, votre bien\-être est une priorité et chaque journée apporte une chance de créer des liens significatifs. Prêt pour un défi vraiment gratifiant? Nous sommes impatients de vous rencontrer.

#### **About the role**


Everflow handles massive scale in the ad\-tech space. We are looking for an AI Engineer who views LLMs as just one component in a complex, high\-concurrency distributed system. You will lead the charge in evolving our platform from "data\-rich" to "intelligence\-driven."


We are a GCP shop, but we don't just follow the documentation—we build ahead of it. You will be responsible for architecting how Gemini and the evolving Vertex AI suite integrate into our real\-time attribution and analytics engine.

#### **The Mission: Build for Today, Architect for Tomorrow**

* **System Orchestration:** Design the "connective tissue" between our massive BigQuery datasets and agentic AI workflows.
* **Rapid Adaptation:** Evaluate and implement emerging GCP technologies (including those announced at Cloud Next) to keep Everflow at the cutting edge of Mar\-Tech.
* **Resilient AI:** Ensure that AI\-driven features—like automated fraud detection or partner insights—are deterministic, cost\-controlled, and sub\-second.

#### **What you'll do**

* **Architectural Agility:** Design modular AI services that allow us to swap models or orchestration frameworks (e.g., moving from manual RAG to autonomous Vertex Agents) as the GCP ecosystem evolves.
* **Tooling \& Function Calling:** Build the secure API layers that allow Gemini to "act" on behalf of our users within the Everflow ecosystem.
* **Latency \& Cost Guardrails:** Engineering the middleware that handles model routing, semantic caching, and token\-budgeting to maintain our margins.
* **Collaborative ML Ops:** Work alongside our Data Scientists to move models from experimental notebooks to production\-grade Cloud Run/GKE deployments.

#### **Qualifications**

* **First Principles Engineer:** You understand the fundamentals of distributed systems, concurrency, and data integrity.
* **GCP Native:** Strong experience with the Google Cloud ecosystem (BigQuery, Pub/Sub, GKE) and Vertex AI.
* **Bilingual:** High proficiency in French and English is required.
* **Montreal Based:** **Ability to work from our Montreal office at least two days per week** to foster high\-bandwidth collaboration with our local engineering hub.
* **Ad\-Tech Sensibility:** You understand that in our world, latency is the enemy and accuracy is the product.

#### **Compensation Package:**

**Base Salary: $100,000 \- $110,000 CAD**  

**Bonus Potential**

##### **Perks include:**

* Employer Medical and Vision Insurance Group Plans
* Unlimited PTO and paid holidays
* Paid parental leave for putting your family first
* Startup\-like environment, without the constant rush to raise the next round of funding
* A very collaborative team and culture
* Education, gym, and equipment stipend

#### **Join Our Exceptional Team**


Dive into a role where respect, ownership, and mindfulness define our culture. As a valued team member, you'll enjoy the freedom to innovate and excel, supported by the tools and equipment you need to succeed.

##### **Balance, Growth, and Connection**

**Work/Life Harmony:** Embrace unlimited PTO and a healthy balance that respects your life outside work.

**Continuous Growth:** Regular feedback and discussions about your career path keep you moving forward.

**Inclusive Community:** Be part of a welcoming, engaging workplace that celebrates diversity and fun.

**We offer a dynamic environment where excellence is rewarded, your well\-being is a priority, and every day brings a chance to make meaningful connections. Ready for a truly rewarding challenge? We're excited to meet you.**

title: Graduate AI Developer
description:
**About the role;**
  

As a Graduate AI Developer you will play a hands\-on role in designing, building, and deploying AI agents as part of TSG’s Applied AI programme. You’ll work within a fast\-growing AI practice that already has a live governance framework, senior AI leadership in place, and multiple production agents delivering measurable outcomes for our people and our customers.
From day one, you’ll be embedded in real builds, learning how AI is designed, governed, tested, and deployed at scale across a Microsoft\-first technology estate. Your focus will be on building AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Power Platform, integrating them with the systems our teams and customers use, including Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Halo ITSM, and Azure AI. You’ll work alongside experienced AI engineers, architects, and security specialists to ensure everything you build meets TSG’s quality, security, and governance standards. This role is structured with clear and accelerated career progression and is designed for individuals who want to build real AI systems early in their careers and progress quickly based on capability.
Please note a 2:1 or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related STEM discipline is an essential requirement for the role.
This is a hybrid position, and candidates are required to be based within the North East.
**Who are we?**
TSG (Technology Services Group) are a Managed IT Services provider supporting businesses UK wide with their technology solutions. As a Microsoft Partner we are committed to delivering excellence for our customers alongside investing in our colleagues to provide them with the knowledge and tools required to deliver great results.
TSG are one of the few Microsoft Partners in the UK who hold all six Microsoft designations, and one of the only partners who specialise in mid\-market. Our commitment to excellence for our customers and employees is backed by our consistent world class NPS score of \+80 and our accreditation as a ‘Great Place to Work’ in addition to being placed on the ‘UK’s Best Workplaces in Tech’ list in both 2024 and again in 2025\. Our guiding principles of Team TSG, Service Excellence and Shared growth are at the heart of everything we do.  


**Why should I work for TSG?**
* Employee ownership – as a growing business we want to ensure that everybody who contributes towards our success, shares in our success. High performing members of Team TSG are entered into an employee benefits trust (EBT). The EBT is the single largest beneficiary within TSG meaning employees will share the benefits of the proceeds, driving a high performing culture with long term value and mutually beneficial outcomes
* Our open and honest culture where feedback is taken on\-board and acted upon
* Our social events – annual all expenses paid ‘TSG Festival’ and team building funds
* Two paid CSR days per annum that you can use to support the community
* Giving something back – the ‘TSG Foundation’ established in November 2022 has so far donated over £160,000 to support nominated businesses and charities
* Our responsibility to the environment as we work towards net carbon zero
* Flexible working opportunities including home working and hybrid options
* Annual salary benchmarking
* Excellent progression opportunities, training and support, including recognised qualifications

**Job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to;**
* Design, build, and deploy low\-code AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint
* Integrate agents with Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 (CRM \& ERP), Halo ITSM, Azure AI, and TSG OneView
* Write and maintain prompts as production deliverables — versioned, reviewed, and tested
* Apply TSG’s AI Governance framework (Action Tier Model, Classification Canon, Edge Case Register, Security Architecture)
* Build robust test sets including golden cases, regression tests, hallucination checks, and output validation
* Instrument every agent with usage and performance metrics from day one
* Complete structured Microsoft learning paths in your first three months
* Work toward PL‑200, PL‑400, and AI‑102 certifications, fully funded by TSG
* Apply learning directly to live customer and internal builds
* Collaborate daily with the AI Director, AI \& BI Practice
* Work with our CISO\-led Cyber team for governance sign\-off
* Engage with the Champion Network, real users providing real feedback
* Support pilot and live deployments, including user onboarding
* Respond quickly to user feedback and iterate fast
* Contribute to the Edge Case Register and shared learnings
* Track and improve agent performance based on data, not assumptions

**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience;**
* 2:1 or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related STEM discipline
* Projects involving LLMs, agents, NLP, or automation are a strong advantage
* Practical understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, and failure modes
* Prompt engineering fundamentals including structured outputs and reasoning techniques
* Grounding and RAG concepts
* Tool and function\-calling patterns in agentic AI
* AI evaluation, testing, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Comfortable with at least one programming language (Python, C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar)
* Exposure to Copilot Studio, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or direct LLM APIs
* Version control using Git
* Evidence of building something end\-to\-end, academic, professional, or personal
* Curious, proactive, and comfortable asking questions early
* Clear communicator with both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Pragmatic, delivery\-focused, and data\-driven
* Collaborative, supportive, and generous with learning

**Benefits;**  

* 25 days annual leave \+ public holidays, rising with length of service
* Employee benefits trust
* Company bonus scheme
* Life assurance 4 x Salary
* Contributory pension scheme at 4% matched
* Healthcare and cash plan
* Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme
* Cycle to work scheme
* Employee discounts
* Employee assistance programme
* Paid CSR Days
* Company sick pay and income protection cover
* Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
* Employee recognition scheme
* Eyecare vouchers
* Discounted gym membership
* Long service rewards

**If this sounds like the role for you, please apply today to be considered.**

**Job Description**

You will work primarily with Anthropic Claude (via AWS Bedrock), Microsoft Copilot, and supporting AWS infrastructure to build robust, production\-grade AI solutions tailored to the utility industry.

**Key Responsibilities** 




**Prompt Design \& Optimization** 



* Design, iterate, and maintain prompt libraries for AWS Agent Core, Claude (Anthropic) and Microsoft Copilot across enterprise use cases including outage communications, meter data analysis, regulatory filings, and customer inquiries.
* Apply advanced prompting techniques — chain\-of\-thought, few\-shot learning, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and tool use — to improve output quality and consistency.
* Build and maintain system prompts, instruction sets, and guardrails aligned with client brand, safety, and compliance standards.
* Conduct A/B testing and prompt regression analysis to benchmark output quality over time.



**AWS \& Infrastructure Integration** 



* Deploy and manage AI workloads on AWS Bedrock, leveraging Claude API integrations, model fine\-tuning pipelines, and serverless architectures (Lambda, API Gateway, S3\).
* Collaborate with cloud architects to build scalable, cost\-efficient prompt orchestration pipelines.
* Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for AI model performance using AWS CloudWatch and related tooling.
* Ensure data privacy and security compliance (CPUC, FERC, SOC 2\) in all AI workflow designs.



**Microsoft Copilot Deployment** 



* Configure and extend Microsoft Copilot across M365 environments (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Power Platform) for field crews, customer service reps, and executive stakeholders.
* Develop Copilot plugins and connectors integrating with enterprise internal systems (SAP, Salesforce, GIS platforms).
* Train internal users and champions on effective Copilot usage; develop prompt guides and self\-service resources.



**Collaboration \& Governance** 



* Partner with legal, compliance, and cybersecurity teams to document AI use cases, risk assessments, and model governance artifacts.
* Participate in the AI Ethics and Responsible Use working group, ensuring equitable and transparent AI deployment.
* Document prompt engineering best practices, version\-control prompt libraries in Git, and contribute to internal knowledge base.
* Stay current on model releases (Claude 3/4, GPT\-4o, Gemini, etc.) and evaluate applicability to utility operations.



  
 



**Qualifications** 




**Required** 



* 3\+ years of experience in prompt engineering, AI/ML engineering, data science, or a closely related field.
* Hands\-on experience with large language models — particularly Anthropic Claude — in production environments.
* Proficiency with AWS services: Bedrock, Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and API Gateway.
* Experience configuring and deploying Microsoft Copilot in enterprise M365 environments.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Familiarity with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting, API calls, and automation.
* Understanding of data privacy regulations relevant to utilities (CPUC Rule 25, etc.).
* Experience with prompt engineering tools, frameworks (LanChain, LlamdaIndex and evaluation methods.



**Preferred** 



* Experience in the energy, utility, or regulated infrastructure sector.
* Exposure to RAG architectures, vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch), or LangChain/LlamaIndex.
* AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect certification.
* Microsoft Certified: AI Engineer Associate or Copilot\-related certification.
* Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce, or GIS platforms common in utility operations.
* Knowledge of NERC CIP, CPUC, or FERC regulatory frameworks.

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.



Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting\-edge technology and data\-driven approach, we're revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.
  

  

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in \+55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.



Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?



Now, let's discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever's mission.

### **The Role**



We're looking for a **Lead AI Engineer** to drive Fever's company\-wide AI transformation. This is a high\-impact role for someone who can build and lead small, high\-performance specialist teams that ship AI initiatives across large business domains — from business development and creative production to investment decisions, operations, and customer experience.



Your focus is applying AI to transform how the business operates. You'll stay at the cutting edge of AI technology being developed around the world and translate it into practical, high\-leverage applications inside Fever — automating workflows, augmenting decision\-making, and unlocking capabilities that weren't possible before. You'll partner with senior leaders across the company to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities, assemble the right squad to tackle them, and deliver production\-grade AI products that change how Fever operates at scale.



This role combines deep technical excellence, hands\-on system design, team leadership, and strategic stakeholder management. You'll set the bar for what AI engineering looks like at Fever and shape how the company adopts AI across every function.


### **What you'll do**


* Lead Fever's AI transformation across multiple business domains, identifying where AI can unlock the largest impact and shaping the roadmap to get there.
* Build and lead small, high\-performance specialist teams — embedding with business stakeholders to ship AI products end\-to\-end, from problem framing to production.
* Design and ship advanced AI systems combining LLMs, agents, retrieval, and orchestration layers, optimized for real business outcomes rather than benchmarks — including high\-volume, low\-latency production workflows.
* Define best practices for AI engineering at Fever: evaluation, observability, cost control, prompt and model governance, safety, and long\-term maintainability.
* Hire, mentor, and grow AI engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and high velocity.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership across business domains, translating AI capabilities into concrete strategy and managing expectations on what's feasible, when, and at what cost.

* Solid grasp of the modern AI stack: foundation model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), vector databases, evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and inference optimization. Comfortable with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability tooling for AI workloads.
* Strong product sense and stakeholder management skills — ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly for impact, and align engineering work with business goals.
* Track record of leading projects across multiple teams and of hiring, mentoring, and growing engineers.

* Experience building agentic systems or AI\-powered automation that replaces or augments human workflows at scale.
